rules.reason: Timing artifact: the html popup-disable-scroll class at capture time depends on the order of OutSystems model flushes (client-variable flush vs local-storage query flush), not on the screen.
rules.evidence: usePopupWidget re-applies disableScroll on every client-variable change as every OS controller does (OutSystems.js:530153 fireInitialize subscribes clientVariablesHandler; :527146 generation++ + scheduleFlush). TST's final html class then depends on whether an EntityDetailsActions model flush (local IDB queries, OnReady) lands after the last client-variable flush; in the mock app local entities resolve in microtasks. TST itself is inconsistent across routes/states: states.json htmlClass default ''/loading 'popup-disable-scroll' on OneSchoolGlobalDetails, but default 'popup-disable-scroll'/loading '' on SupperMeeting_Carousel. See migration/screens/OneSchoolGlobalDetails/analysis/states.json and parity/<state>.json.
